title: Caregiver as Navigator: Develop Skills Online (CAN-DO)
official: Caregiver as Navigator: Develop Skills Online (CAN-DO) Developing Dementia Family Caregiver Mastery for Navigating Complex Health, Social Service, Legal, Financial, and Family Systems
summary: This study is designed to learn more about ways to promote caregiver mastery online. 270 dementia family caregivers will be enrolled and randomized to take the CAN-DO online course immediately or after a waiting period. They will participate in interviews before and after the course; total time of study participation is 6 months.

interventions.name: Caregiver as Navigator: Develop Skills Online (CAN-DO) program

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Family member or friend providing at least 4 hours per week of informal care for a community-dwelling person living with ADRD
* 18 years or older
* Has internet access
* Does not have to co-reside with the individual
* Understands, speaks, and reads English

Exclusion Criteria:

* Family caregiver plans to move care recipient to an institutional setting within the next six months
* Care recipient currently enrolled in hospice

sites.f: Emory Roybal Center for Dementia Caregiving Mastery
